text: a driver MUST start a lane change or a pass ONLY IF the driver has first made sure there is [?enough] space and time to complete it [?safely] IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: The Act puts the same judgment on the driver and gives no measure. For a lane change the handbook's road test gives one: at least a 2 to 3 s gap behind the vehicle ahead in the new lane, not beside another vehicle or in its blind spot.

text: a driver MUST NOT pass a vehicle UNLESS the driver has first made [?sure] the pass can be made without danger to the driver or others IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: For a pass that moves from one lane to another, which is every pass but one within the lane.

text: a driver approaching from the rear MUST NOT let the front of the driver's vehicle pass beyond the front of another vehicle WHEN the other vehicle is approaching a pedestrian crossover AND is within 30 m of it IF VIOLATED 4 demerit points
note: Measured front to front, as the Act states it.

text: a driver MUST NOT drive left of the centre of the road WHEN the road has one or more lanes in each direction AND the driver is within 30 m of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel AND the driver's view is obstructed within that distance UNLESS the road has more lanes in one direction than in the other OR the road is one-way IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: The Act bans the means, driving left of centre, so it covers passing there but not a pass that stays right of centre. Road service vehicles taking precautions are also exempt (149 (2) (b)).

text: a driver MUST NOT drive left of the centre of the road WHEN the road has one or more lanes in each direction AND (the driver is approaching the crest of a hill OR the driver is on a curve) AND the driver's view is obstructed so that a vehicle coming the other way would be a [?potential hazard] UNLESS the road has more lanes in one direction than in the other OR the road is one-way IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: The Act's test, "a potential hazard", is as open as the handbook's "not enough to pass safely". The engineering measure, passing sight distance in OTM Book 11, was not obtained.

text: a driver MUST NOT use a two-way left-turn lane for passing WHEN the lane is marked with the two-way left-turn lane sign
note: The sign makes the lane for left turns only.

text: a driver MAY pass WHEN there is a broken line at the left of the driver's lane ONLY IF the road in front of and to the left of the vehicle being passed is [?safely] free of approaching traffic AND the road to the left of the driver is [?safely] free of overtaking traffic AND there are [?enough] broken lines ahead to complete the pass IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: "The way is clear" becomes the Act's two conditions; "safely" is the Act's own word.

text: a driver MUST NOT pass WHEN a "do not pass" sign applies to the road
a driver MUST NOT move from one lane to another UNLESS the driver has first made sure the move can be made [?safely] IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: The duty the merge falls under.

text: a driver travelling at less than the normal speed of traffic at that time and place MUST drive in the right-hand lane then available for traffic OR as close as [?practicable] to the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway WHEN [?practicable] IF VIOLATED a fine of $150 to $1,000
note: Law only for a vehicle slower than the normal speed of traffic; the handbook asks every driver on a freeway.

text: a driver MUST pass on the left BECAUSE passing on the right can be more dangerous
note: Passing on the right is lawful only in the cases of 3.2.3b.

text: EXCEPTION TO 3.2.3a: a driver MAY pass on the right ONLY IF the pass can be made [?in safety] AND (the vehicle being passed is making or about to make a left turn OR its driver has signalled a left turn OR the road has unobstructed pavement wide enough for 2 or more lines of vehicles in each direction OR the road is one-way OR the vehicle being passed is a streetcar) IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: "Multi-lane" is the Act's pavement wide enough for two or more lines of vehicles in each direction; a streetcar must be passed on the right (3.4.5a).

text: a driver MUST NOT pass a vehicle by driving off the roadway IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: The prohibition the permission presupposes.

text: a driver MAY pass on the right shoulder ONLY IF the shoulder is paved AND (the vehicle being passed is making or about to make a left turn OR its driver has signalled a left turn) AND the pass can be made [?in safety]
note: The exception to the line above.

text: a driver MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder, whether or not it is paved IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points

a driver MUST stop before reaching a stopped school bus WHEN the bus has its overhead red lights flashing OR its stop arm actuated, from either direction IF VIOLATED a fine of $400 to $2,000 for a first offence AND 6 demerit points
note: The demerit table lists 6 points for 175 (11) and (12), the red-light duties; it names no points for the stop-arm duties.

text: a driver MUST stop at least 20 m before reaching the bus WHEN approaching from the rear a stopped school bus with its overhead red lights flashing OR its stop arm actuated IF VIOLATED a fine of $400 to $2,000 for a first offence

a driver MUST NOT proceed WHEN stopped for a school bus UNTIL the bus moves OR (the overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND the stop arm is no longer actuated) IF VIOLATED a fine of $400 to $2,000 for a first offence AND 6 demerit points
note: Each signal is its own duty; a signal that was not on does not have to stop.

text: a driver MUST slow down AND proceed with [?caution], so as not to collide with the stopped vehicle or endanger anyone outside it, WHEN approaching, on the same side of the road, an emergency vehicle stopped with red or red-and-blue lights flashing OR a tow truck stopped with amber lights flashing IF VIOLATED a fine of $400 to $2,000 for a first offence AND 3 demerit points
note: From January 1, 2027 the Act also covers a stopped work-related vehicle with amber flashing lamps.

text: a driver in the same lane as the stopped vehicle or the lane next to it MUST move into another lane [?if safe to do so] WHEN an emergency vehicle with red or red-and-blue lights flashing OR a tow truck with amber lights flashing is stopped AND the road has 2 or more lanes in the driver's direction IF VIOLATED a fine of $400 to $2,000 for a first offence AND 3 demerit points
note: The Act says "if the movement can be made safely". From January 1, 2027 it also covers a stopped work-related vehicle with amber flashing lamps.

text: a cyclist MAY use any part of the lane WHEN this is [?necessary for safety], for example to discourage passing where the lane is too narrow to be shared [?safely]
note: The "where practicable" of 147 (1): a slower vehicle keeps right only where practicable.

text: a driver of a motor vehicle MUST keep at least 1 m between the right side of the vehicle and the left side of the bicycle, including all projections and attachments, WHEN [?practicable] WHILE passing a cyclist UNTIL the vehicle is [?safely] past the bicycle IF VIOLATED a fine of $60 to $1,000 AND 2 demerit points
a driver MUST pass a streetcar on the right UNLESS the streetcar is on a one-way road IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: Fire department vehicles going to a fire are exempt.

text: a driver MUST NOT pass a streetcar OR come nearer than 2 m to it, measured back from the nearest door passengers use, WHEN the streetcar is stopped to take on or let off passengers UNTIL the passengers have got on OR have got safely to the side of the street IF VIOLATED 3 demerit points
note: Not where a safety zone is designated by by-law (3.4.5c).

text: a driver MUST NOT overtake a snow plow that is travelling in echelon with other plows UNLESS the lane the driver uses to overtake is entirely clear of every part of the plow, including attachments and the blade, WHEN the speed limit is 80 km/h or more AND the road has 2 or more marked lanes in the driver's direction

a driver being overtaken MUST turn out to the right AND let the overtaking vehicle pass WHEN a vehicle travelling at a greater speed overtakes the driver IF VIOLATED a fine of $150 to $1,000 AND 2 demerit points
note: Every driver who is overtaken, towing or not (3.6.1a).

text: a driver being overtaken MUST turn out to the right AND let the overtaking vehicle pass WHEN a vehicle travelling at a greater speed overtakes the driver IF VIOLATED a fine of $150 to $1,000 AND 2 demerit points
note: The Act has no "in safety" qualifier.

text: a driver MUST NOT drive in a manner that indicates an intention to prevent another vehicle from passing IF VIOLATED a fine of $2,000 to $10,000 OR up to 6 months in jail OR both AND a licence suspension of at least 1 year for a first conviction AND 6 demerit points AND, at the roadside, a 30-day licence suspension AND a 14-day vehicle impoundment
note: A stunt under s. 172 of the Act.

text: a driver travelling at less than the normal speed of traffic at that time and place MUST keep right WHEN on a multi-lane road where a "slower traffic keep right" sign is posted
note: 147 (1) asks this on any road, signed or not, where practicable.

text: a driver of a commercial motor vehicle more than 6.5 m long, alone or with a towed vehicle, MUST NOT drive in the left lane WHEN on a highway portion described in the Schedules to Reg. 608 AND the left lane is not a high occupancy vehicle lane
note: Subject to s. 1 (2), which was not pulled.

text: a driver of a commercial motor vehicle more than 6.5 m long, alone or with a towed vehicle, MUST NOT drive in the lane next to the high occupancy vehicle lane WHEN on a highway portion described in the Schedules to Reg. 608 AND the left lane is a high occupancy vehicle lane

a driver of a commercial motor vehicle more than 6.5 m long, alone or with a towed vehicle, MUST NOT drive in the left lane WHEN on a highway portion described in the Schedules to Reg. 608 AND the left lane is not a high occupancy vehicle lane
note: The regulation only bars the left lane; that trucks pass in the next lane is the handbook's reading of it.

text: a driver in the truck passing lane MUST move into the right-hand lane [?as soon as the driver can] WHEN a truck travelling at a greater speed overtakes the driver IF VIOLATED a fine of $150 to $1,000 AND 2 demerit points
note: The Act gives no time.
